MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next purchase because it would let me control a lamp through the Echo devices I already own.",
    "The Alexa-compatible security cameras fit my interest in home electronics and my earlier door alarm purchase, while adding a capability beyond my current speakers and displays."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dot, Show 5 and Fire TV Stick duplicate devices I recently bought in newer versions, so their familiarity does not give me a reason to buy them.",
    "Neither pair of earbuds addresses a current need, and my computer accessories do not establish that I use an iPhone.",
    "Echo Auto carries Alexa into the car, but my recent purchases point toward using it at home."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it repeats something I own or serves a different setting.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed desire for wireless earbuds without evidence that I am shopping for personal audio."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent fourth-generation Dot, second-generation Show 5 and Fire TV Stick 4K Max purchases matter because they already cover the uses offered by several recommendations.",
    "Buying a stand for my Show 5 suggests I am completing that setup; a larger display can interest me without being something I want to buy immediately.",
    "I am more interested in adding a useful home capability than collecting similar devices, and I would consider the whole-home security bundle before a separate three-camera pack."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in Alexa at home but missed the difference between extending my setup and duplicating recent purchases."
}
